summary: Square Enix's choice-driven narrative adventure series, including the original episodic Arcadia Bay story, sequels, remasters, and later Max Caulfield follow-ups.

entries.title: Life Is Strange
entries.definitive_edition: Life Is Strange Complete Season original PC release

emulation.notes: Use the native PC version for the original release.

primary.version: Life Is Strange Complete Season original PC release
primary.why: The original Windows complete-season route preserves the 2015 art direction and all five episodes while allowing the cleanest capture and PC display settings. The remaster is tracked separately because it changes presentation and is not needed to preserve the original release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Complete Season through Steam or another legitimate PC storefront; use native resolution and controller or mouse/keyboard by preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Life Is Strange Remastered changes the presentation and is tracked separately; this row preserves the original release.

entries.title: Life Is Strange: Before the Storm

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Deluxe Edition or equivalent complete package.

primary.version: Life Is Strange: Before the Storm Deluxe Edition
primary.why: The Windows Deluxe Edition is the best complete route because it includes the three-episode prequel and the Farewell bonus episode while keeping PC capture/display flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Deluxe Edition or equivalent complete bundle including Farewell; keep the remastered version separate unless specifically comparing presentation changes.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Remastered Collection is separate; use this row for the original presentation plus Farewell content.

entries.title: The Awesome Adventures of Captain Spirit

emulation.notes: Use the native free PC release.

primary.why: The game is a free Life Is Strange 2 introduction released on PS4, Windows, and Xbox One; Windows is the cleanest capture route with no platform-exclusive content documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the free Windows release through Steam; optionally keep the save/context before Life Is Strange 2.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or separate definitive edition is documented.

emulation.notes: Use the native PC complete season.

primary.why: The Windows complete-season route covers all five episodes with native PC capture and display flexibility; no sourced platform-exclusive story content requires a secondary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Complete Season through Steam or another legitimate PC storefront; play Captain Spirit first if you want the intended lead-in context.

entries.title: Life Is Strange: True Colors

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Deluxe Edition with Wavelengths.

primary.version: Life Is Strange: True Colors Deluxe Edition with Wavelengths
primary.why: Windows provides the highest-fidelity native route, and the Deluxe Edition adds the Wavelengths DLC starring Steph, making it the complete play route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Deluxe Edition or equivalent bundle including Wavelengths; use current PC settings for the best capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster is documented; the Ultimate bundle includes the separate Remastered Collection rather than changing True Colors itself.

entries.title: Life Is Strange Remastered Collection

emulation.notes: Use the native PC remastered collection for remastered visuals.

primary.version: Life Is Strange Remastered Collection PC release
primary.why: This collection remasters Life Is Strange and Before the Storm; Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the remastered presentation, while the original versions remain preferable in their own rows when preserving original art direction.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Remastered Collection only when you specifically want the remastered visuals; use the original PC rows for original-version preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use as a remaster route, not a replacement for the original-version archive rows.

primary.version: Life Is Strange: Double Exposure PC release
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route for the 2024 current-generation sequel; Switch is a later portable port and PS5/Xbox Series are strong alternatives without sourced exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam or Windows Store; use the Deluxe/Ultimate cosmetics only if desired because the main story is in the base game.

primary.version: Life Is Strange: Reunion PC release
primary.why: The 2026 Reunion release is available for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route with no exclusive story content on console.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam or Windows Store after Double Exposure; use the Twin Pack only if you also need Double Exposure.
